title: repro pick falls back to each instance's own areas when one instance finished no area
goal: bench_repro.standings takes the common areas over the instances that finished at least one area and ranks an instance that finished none last, so one instance whose every area failed no longer makes pick compare the others on unequal area sets (found by the SP-75hdeqld review as S2, carrying the change of ST-vexo3oze's gate g1)

import csv, sys, tempfile, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_repro as b

def row(scen, n, case, metric, value):
    return {'scenario': scen, 'record': 'r', 'date': '2026-10-24', 'arm': f'instance-{n}', 'case': case, 'metric': metric, 'value': str(value)}

rows = []
for n, errors in ((1, 5), (2, 4)):
    rows += [row('repro-compare', n, a, 'eval_passed', 0) for a in 'ab'] + [row('repro-compare', n, 'all', 'check_errors', errors), row('repro-compare', n, 'all', 'lint_errors', 0)]
rows += [row('repro-compare', 3, a, 'eval_passed', 50) for a in 'ab'] + [row('repro', 3, a, 'failure', 'boom') for a in 'ab']
rows += [row('repro-compare', 3, 'all', 'check_errors', 0), row('repro-compare', 3, 'all', 'lint_errors', 0)]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    f = pathlib.Path(d, 'res.csv')
    with open(f, 'w', newline='') as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=['scenario', 'record', 'date', 'commit', 'claude_code', 'kb_topics', 'case', 'arm', 'model', 'metric', 'value', 'runs', 'note'], restval='')
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    lines = []
    rc = b.pick(str(f), out=lines.append)
order = [l.split(':')[0] for l in lines if l.startswith('instance-')]
print(rc, order, lines[-1])
sys.exit(0 if rc == 0 and order[-1] == 'instance-3' and lines[-1].startswith('picked: instance-2') else 1)
